title: Core existence for a regular complete finite subring
statement: A complete local Noetherian domain admits a regular complete local subring over which it is finite.

proof.text: This is the corresponding strictly smaller intermediate assertion in the coefficient-ring and parameter construction of Tag 032D.

lean.statement: theorem complete_local_domain_finite_over_regular_core (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R] : ∃ (R₀ : Subring R), ∃ hreg : IsRegularLocalRing R₀, let _ := hreg.toIsLocalRing IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R₀) R₀ ∧ Module.Finite R₀ R
